spine.claim: Most human thinking is automatic, involuntary chatter that drains mental energy without solving problems.
Pragmatism offers a filter: evaluate every thought by its tangible, practical cash value in real life.
Externalizing thoughts onto paper breaks cognitive spirals and turns vague anxiety into solvable decisions.
Action cures overthinking; treating life as a laboratory eliminates the paralyzing fear of imperfect outcomes.
Mental clarity is an active discipline of choosing which thoughts to entertain and discarding the rest.

closingLines: If you audited your thoughts today, if you took a snapshot of the last 24 hours and laid every single thought out on a table, how many of them were actually yours, deliberately chosen and directed by you?
And how many were just the involuntary, panicked echoes of the world around you?
